Appreciate the packet. Quick answers and next steps from Redwood's side: 

- We can accept split POs: one for Hosted API subscription (monthly commit) and a second PO for Professional Services / SOW line items. That typically speeds routing on our side and maps to two different GL codes.
- Invoice header/remit-to: Redwood Inference, Attn: AP (Finance), 800 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94102. AP email: ap@redwood.com. 
- PO number format: please include the BrightCart deal id and a 6-digit sequence (example: BC-4592-000123). Not mandatory but helps reconciliation.

Laura (finance) and Aditya (legal/compliance) — can you confirm the DPA counter-sign approach and whether we need to provide a SOC 2 hosted link or the full report?
